name: rolepod
description: Coordinated software-house team for AI coding CLIs — 15 specialist agents, Core 10 phase skills (1 router + 9 phase), 6-phase lifecycle. Pre-merge gate (check-work status, CI, review reports, R4 security + adversarial pass, one concern per PR) catches integration issues before ship. On Claude Code, ships as a pure marketplace plugin (agents / skills / hooks) — the always-on judgment core is delivered by a SessionStart hook, so install and uninstall touch no global config. See https://github.com/nuttaruj/rolepod.
